answer: Ephemeral Work-Proof Windows. Each identity must submit a fresh, verifiable task receipt within a rolling window tied to a per-identity hardware timer whose seed is derived from a violet noise beacon. Missed windows void accrued rewards and forfeit the identity's residual balance. Cloned identities share nothing else, so each clone pays full compute and window-maintenance cost while earning only partial reward before expiry.
